In Jpn and Pol. Profile Lanatoside C is a cardiac glycoside with positive inotropic activ- ity. It is obtained from digitalis lanata leaf (p.1258). It has general properties similar to those of digoxin (p.1259) and has been used in the treatment of some cardiac arrhythmias and in heart failure. Mixtures of lanatosides A, B, and C have also been used. Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Arg.: Develanid†; Mex.: Cedilanid.
